Restart the SQL Server Full-Text Filter Daemon Host service to reset communication channels between SQL Server and fdhost.exe.
Run DBCC CHECKDB on databases with full-text indexes to identify any underlying data corruption that may be affecting full-text operations.
Check AWS FSx for NetApp ONTAP storage health and network connectivity, as storage-level issues can manifest as full-text communication errors.
Rebuild full-text catalogs using ALTER FULLTEXT CATALOG catalog_name REBUILD to resolve potential index corruption.
Review SQL Server error logs and Windows Event Logs for additional fdhost.exe related errors that may provide more specific failure details.

remediation: Resource Governor is currently disabled (is_enabled: false) on instance STVYK7H. Enable Resource Governor using 'ALTER RESOURCE GOVERNOR RECONFIGURE' if external resource management is required.

Check if SQL Server Machine Learning Services feature is installed. If external script execution is needed, install this feature through SQL Server Setup.
Verify SQL Server Launchpad service status using 'services.msc' or PowerShell. Start the service if it exists but is stopped.
If Launchpad service is not installed and external script execution is not required, this error can be safely ignored as it does not affect core SQL Server functionality.
